Bonds of Time - P003: Water Around Stones

The third part of Bonds of Time; will be readable without paywall next week on Monday 2025-10-06 at around 8AM JST. In the meantime it's available behind a paywall!

Marcus and the Tang girl emerge from the iron serpent onto a platform that defies all logic.

From this part forward, I'm aiming for approximately 1000 words per installment to give the story more room to breathe and develop!
